verdict: CONTESTED -- casting-robust core, but the headline 'divergence' is a circular/near-restatement finding, not a field-redirecting discovery. WHAT SURVIVES: The structural core is sound and honest. The foreclosure (emergence-up, E3, non-definable from the IR) is genuinely casting-robust (both endpoint cards confirm E009 stays E3 under any formulation; E008's clean down-factorization makes E009's up non-factorization real, not a modeling artifact). The non-descending object (UV-fiber selector = kernel-content of the E008 many-to-one projection) is correctly identified as emergence-up and cleanly separated from the matched-coupling VALUE leg (E008's E0 value_split). Anti-reductionism §9 is honored throughout: no derive-across-layers, up/down asymmetry kept (E009 non-runnable, E008 runnable-down), foreclosure treated as the framework working, primer §4 (iteration saturates; only package change reaches the fiber) correctly invoked, and the card explicitly refuses to mis-cast this as F51 common-refinement. NO content overclaim: remains_unknown_content disclaims naming the theory; string/asymptotic-safety/new-dof are listed only as candidate substrates. WHAT FAILS: The advertised payload -- the 'partial divergence' that the author hopes is field-redirecting -- does NOT survive as a discovery. (a) It is largely a RESTATEMENT of the accepted landscape/swampland/vacuum-selection problem; convention already knows supplying a UV completion does not close vacuum selection, so 'selection not mere completion' diverges from a strawman, not from real convention. (b) Its grounding is CIRCULAR: E037 is used both to build the divergence AND as its claimed out-of-sample confirmation; the one genuinely held-out, falsifiable test (E015-inverse, qed->electroweak_theory, predicting E2-named-import for a small fiber) is admittedly NOT YET CHARTED. So the redirecting claim currently rests on in-sample evidence plus a strawman comparator. Per the discipline, a motivated divergence whose confirmation is circular and whose content is already textbook must be downgraded -- this is 'casting-dependent / contested', reframing a known open problem, NOT a discovery. The card is honest about its hedges (confidence 'firm-but-testable', 'not a claim conventional physics is wrong'), which is why it survives at 2.5 rather than lower; but the firewall does not pass as field-redirecting.
